title: 234 ChatGPT prompts (and how to write your own)
summary: Copy-ready 234 ChatGPT prompts for marketing, SEO, sales, and 10+ use cases, plus the PROMPT framework for writing your own.
body_markdown:
## Speed up your workflow with ChatGPT prompts


The prompts in this article are starting points. The PROMPT framework shapes them to your task by adding your context, format, rules, and source material.


The free Prompt Optimizer applies the framework for you. Grab a prompt from this list, describe your task, or paste a prompt that isn’t working. You get a ready-to-use prompt, a short note on what changed and why, and a few checks to tell whether the output is right.


Then tune it. Run the prompt and review the response. If it misses, paste the response back, and the optimizer fixes the part responsible. For tasks you repeat, it builds a reusable template your team can share.


### Download your free Prompt Optimizer


Use your Prompt Optimizer inside your favorite AI chatbot like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any coding agent of choice.


### How to use your Prompt Optimizer


**For use in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot:** Add the[prompt-optimizer.md](http://prompt-optimizer.md/) file to a new chat and enter you prompt in the text field.


Answer the questions from the tool to get started.


**For use in Claude Code or Codex:** Download the .zip file, open it, and add the new Prompt Optimizer folder to your AI agent.


Then type “Run the Prompt Optimizer.”


Answer the questions so the AI has what it needs to optimize your prompt.


Run your tool as often as you need.


**[Download your free Prompt Optimizer](https://static.semrush.com/blog/uploads/files/f5/f6/f5f60365f3c481be3d14ec8bbd038c87/prompt-optimizer.zip) .**
